{{Quote|I see through her eyes. My apprentice dreams of her past under the light of a red sun.|The Emperor, speaking through his Voice|<ref name="Blood 1" />}}
A '''Human''' was used by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] as his [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Voice]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Through the Human, the Emperor oversaw the creation of the agents known as the [[Children of the Emperor]] and ordered the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]] to [[Hunt for Exal Kressh|hunt down]] his traitorous [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Exal Kressh]], though the Human was eventually replaced by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|This is the weapon you have chosen?''"<br />"''Yes, my Emperor.|The Emperor and Darth Marr|<ref name="Blood 1" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] was used as the host, or [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Voice]], of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] essence<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> during the first [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3678 BBY]], the Emperor's host was present in the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] on the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] when he requested that the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]] find him someone to [[Hunt for Exal Kressh|hunt down]] his wayward apprentice [[Exal Kressh]]. When [[Darth Marr]], a member of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]], brought the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]] before him, the Emperor informed the boy that he would find Kressh in the [[Lenico system/Legends|Lenico system]]. Ignoring Kel's attempts to speak, the Human then reached out to place his fingertips upon the apprentice's forehead, causing Kel to collapse at the touch of the Emperor's mind as the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ruler sifted through his consciousness.<ref name="Blood 1" /> The Human eventually [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="The Voice of Darkness" /> and was replaced sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], when the Emperor took a [[Unidentified Emperor's Voice (Voss)|member]] of the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as his Voice.<ref name="Voss-Date" />

==Personality and traits==
A bald Human with tan skin and [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], the Voice spoke with the Emperor's own emotionless voice,<ref name="Blood 1" /> and their original personality was entirely wiped away by the Emperor's possession of their body.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The voice does not belong to mortals. To speak in its presence seems heresy.|Teneb Kel's thoughts on the Voice|<ref name="Blood 1" />}}
The Human thought to be the Emperor first appeared in [[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith|''Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith'']], an issue in the webcomics relating to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. First published on [[April 23]], [[2010]],<ref name="Blood 1" /> the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] featured the first image of the Emperor, though the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' contradicted the issue by stating that he was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]].<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> However, the [[Sith Warrior]] class story in ''The Old Republic'' resolved this by explaining the mechanism of the Voice,<ref name="The Voice of Darkness" /> and the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' further clarified the situation by stating that the Sith Pureblood body seen in the novel was the Emperor's original body, as he only began to use Voices after the events of the novel.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
